bugs.title: makedumpfile 1.7.0 cannot identify hugetlb pages

findings.message: Bug LP: #2175732 is not targeted at makedumpfile and jammy

blockers.summary: The test plan is inconsistent. The example kernel command line reserves 4 x 1G hugepages (hugepages=4), but the expected Test 1 numbers assume 50 x 1 GiB (13107200 pages), so a verifier following it literally cannot reproduce the figures. The heading "without crashing the V:" is also garbled.
